component.name: WhattyTheShell!
component.summary: GTK4 GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with Vulkan rendering

description.p: WhattyTheShell is a fast, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator built with GTK4 and Rust. It features zero-copy Vulkan dmabuf texture sharing, horizontal and vertical tabs, full VT100/Xterm emulation, and VS Code theme integration.
